About the Slow Roll Cleveland group ride

About ten miles at an easy pace through a different Cleveland neighborhood every Monday. Hundreds of riders of all backgrounds and abilities. Check the schedule for that week's meeting spot.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
